title: Bahnsen's notes on unexplained effect

tellings.quote: And Bonson writes in his notes that there's something going on here that we're unable to account for.

plain: In the 1950s in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, a man named Agnew Bahnson wrote in his notes that experiments he was following had produced an effect nobody could explain. The researcher Paul Schatzkin, speaking in an episode about the inventor Townsend Brown, tells Michels that Bahnson wrote 'there's something going on here that we're unable to account for.' Schatzkin offers this as a sign that the work turned up something real, though he names no source beyond the notes.
